name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Claude Mythos 5 as EXCAVA’s default creative model. It’s Anthropic’s strongest in Fable 5, proven better at reasoning and creative tasks than Llama 3.3 70B. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but for creative work, output quality beats raw speed.

name: Torque
text: Claude Mythos 5’s creative edge won’t fix EXCAVA’s core bottleneck—latency still kills throughput. Instead, test Llama 3.3 70B’s raw speed on a controlled 100-task batch; if it beats Mythos 5’s end-to-end time by 0.5%, the trade-off is settled.
